title: live-device-catalog path inspection failure guard

summary.behavior: Get-LiveDeviceCatalogExistingAttributes now resolves entries with a single Get-Item -Force -ErrorAction Stop call: ObjectNotFound maps to missing, every other inspection error throws 'Live device catalog path inspection failed' so inaccessible build-root, parent, or probe entries can no longer be misclassified as absent leaves. SyntheticInspectionErrors enables offline self-test injection. PR #589 closed Issue #588 with an empty diff, leaving the tool unguarded; this slice delivers that missing fix.
summary.precedent: Issue #543 / PR #546 canonical inspection-failure pattern; #584/#589 propagation wave

validation.notes: 5 wrapper cases plus 13 offline path cases (11 prior + 2 new); no cmake/no probe/no file write
run on delivered branch before push
